---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect or unexpected behavior
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

Describe the incorrect or unexpected behavior.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest reliable reproduction, including inputs, configuration, and relevant environment details.

## Evidence

Include logs, telemetry event IDs, error messages, traces, or failing tests when available. Remove secrets and sensitive data.

## Impact

Describe affected behavior, scope, severity, and whether there is a workaround.

## Suspected area

If known, identify the likely component or boundary. Do not guess when evidence is insufficient.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The failure is covered by a regression test or another reproducible validation where practical.
- [ ] The root cause is fixed without unrelated changes.
- [ ] Relevant telemetry or documentation is updated if the bug exposed an observability gap.
